title: Targeting a MYC-directed metabolic vulnerability sensitizes tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy with selectivity
task: Identify tumor-specific metabolic vulnerabilities in NSCLC to enhance TKI sensitivity
key_results: Vandetanib suppresses MYC-driven serine synthesis pathway (SSP) transcription; MYC regulates SSP more strongly than GCN2–ATF4 in tumor cells; vandetanib + serine/glycine restriction achieves potent tumor suppression with reduced toxicity to normal cells
comments: Elegant example of exploiting oncogene-specific transcriptional dependencies; selectivity margin between tumor and normal cells requires careful clinical validation.

model_io.model: NSCLC tumor and normal cell lines, in vivo NSCLC xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vandetanib represses SSP transcription via MYC suppression in NSCLC
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: vandetanib inhibits MYC-driven SSP regulation more effectively than canonical GCN2–ATF4 pathway

hypotheses.hypothesis: MYC-directed SSP blockade combined with serine/glycine deprivation induces selective tumor cell death
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: combination achieved potent tumor suppression with sparing of normal cells reliant on GCN2–ATF4 pathway

title: STF-62247 induces a non-canonical, caspase-independent cell death in ccRCC associated with autophagic and lysosomal dysfunction
task: Characterize the cell death mechanism induced by STF-62247 in ccRCC with different genetic profiles
key_results: STF-62247 induces non-canonical, caspase-independent death in SETD2-inactivated cells; PIKfyve inhibition causes endolysosomal enlargement trapping pro-cathepsin L; ATG5/BECN1 knockout partially rescued viability
comments: Complex multi-pathway death phenotype complicates therapeutic prediction; unclear whether the autophagic response is adaptive or pathological.

model_io.model: VHL-deficient and SETD2-inactivated ccRCC cells, CRISPR knockouts (CASP3, GSDME, ATG5, BECN1)
outputs: apoptosis markers (cytochrome c, PARP, caspase cleavage)

hypotheses.hypothesis: STF-62247 induces caspase-dependent apoptosis in VHL-deficient cells
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed in VHL-deficient cells; rejected in SETD2-inactivated cells where caspase activation is absent

hypotheses.hypothesis: PIKfyve inhibition triggers lysosomal membrane permeabilization
hypotheses.result: Rejected: no LAMP1 translocation or functional lysosomal rupture; instead endolysosomal enlargement traps degradative enzymes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Autophagy contributes to STF-62247-mediated death in SETD2-inactivated cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ATG5/BECN1 knockout and SAR405 partially rescued viability

title: PRMT1 methylates SKP1 to inhibit the ubiquitination of pro-proliferative phosphoproteins during hepatocyte proliferation
task: Determine how PRMT1-mediated SKP1 methylation stabilizes pro-proliferative phosphoproteins during liver regeneration
key_results: PRMT1 catalyzes asymmetric dimethylation of SKP1 at R81, disrupting FBXW7 recruitment to SCF complex; SAM supplementation accelerates liver regeneration in mice and patients
comments: Demonstrates proof-of-concept for metabolite supplementation as regenerative therapy, though the clinical translatability and optimal dosing remain to be established.

model_io.model: hepatocyte proliferation assay, liver regeneration in mice and humans

hypotheses.hypothesis: PRMT1 upregulation by EGF signaling methylates SKP1 to prevent FBXW7-mediated degradation of pro-proliferative phosphoproteins
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: R81 methylation disrupts FBXW7 recruitment and stabilizes target substrates

hypotheses.hypothesis: SAM supplementation enhances PRMT1-catalyzed methylation and accelerates hepatocyte proliferation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: SAM administration significantly accelerated liver regeneration in vivo

title: Small-molecule targeting of kinesin-13 KIF2C enhances double-strand break DNA repair and slows down aging
task: Determine whether KIF2C activation can counteract DNA damage and aging
key_results: KIF2C agonist enhanced DSB repair in HGPS and DS cells; subcutaneous injection in progeria mice extended lifespan and improved healthspan
comments: Novel connection between microtubule-driven nuclear envelope dynamics and genome stability; mechanism may be broadly geroprotective.

model_io.model: aged cells, patient-derived HGPS and DS cells, progeria mouse model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increased KIF2C activity restores nuclear envelope invaginations and enhances DSB repair
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: agonist improved assembly of microtubule-driven invaginations and DSB repair in multiple cell types and in vivo

title: Excess type I interferon disrupts developmental crosstalk and promotes premature distalization in trisomy 21 lungs
task: Elucidate mechanisms of congenital lung anomalies in Trisomy 21
key_results: IFN-I hyperactivation recapitulates T21 lung pathology; mesenchyme-derived IFN-I shifts epithelial progenitors toward AT2-like differentiation
comments: While mechanistically insightful, the study does not yet demonstrate therapeutic efficacy of IFN-I pathway inhibition in vivo.

model_io.model: human lung tissue explants with single-cell RNA-seq

hypotheses.hypothesis: IFN-I hyperactivation is necessary and sufficient to drive T21 lung pathology
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: IFN treatment recapitulates T21 transcriptional changes and promotes epithelial remodeling

title: Silencing of LOXL4 inhibits colorectal cancer progression via regulating GLS1-dependent glutamine metabolism
task: Identify metabolic mechanisms driving LOXL4-dependent colorectal cancer progression
key_results: LOXL4 knockout downregulated GLS1, causing glutamine accumulation and glutamate reduction; CB-839 (GLS1 inhibitor) synergized with LOXL4 deletion to suppress tumor growth
comments: Mechanistic elegance is undermined by lack of clarity on how LOXL4 specifically regulates GLS1 at the molecular level.

model_io.model: LOXL4 knockout CRC cell lines (SW480, HT-29), AOM/DSS-induced CRC mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: LOXL4 silencing suppresses CRC progression via GLS1 downregulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: LOXL4 knockout reduced GLS1 and impaired malignant behaviors; exogenous glutamate rescued proliferation

hypotheses.hypothesis: GLS1 inhibition synergizes with LOXL4 deletion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: CB-839 further potentiated anti-tumor effects of LOXL4 depletion in vivo

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tri-part combinatorial barcode design enables accurate spatial assignment of long reads on high-density arrays

title: Vision-semantic alignment with hierarchical consistency constraints for multi-attribute museum artifact classification

key_results: 85.2% hierarchical F1 on Met Museum dataset (6.9pp gain over baseline); 2.8% hierarchical violation rate reduced to 0% with constrained decoding

title: Evaluation of large language models’ responses to patient questions about avascular necrosis of the femoral head

key_results: Claude/DeepSeek ranked highest on clinical accuracy (p<0.001); all responses safe; readability scores (FKGL 10.85-13.93) exceeded recommended grade levels

model_io.model: FS-VMADW (Frequency-Spatial Vision Mamba Dual Watermarking)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining spatial Vision Mamba with frequency DWT branch improves both imperceptibility and recovery fidelity
hypotheses.result: FS-VMADW achieved superior PSNR/SSIM/BER metrics compared to CNN and Transformer alternatives

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-phase curriculum training mitigates gradient conflict between imperceptibility and extraction objectives
hypotheses.result: Successful decoupling across training phases yielded 0.9509 BitAcc and 0.9511 NC

title: Facial expression recognition based on multi-scale dual-channel attention mechanism

title: Unifying quantum smoothing theories with extended retrodiction

key_results: Quantum smoothing formulated as extended Bayesian retrodiction; prior-correlation dependence identified as uniquely quantum feature; unified framework encompasses previous incompatible approaches
comments: Theoretically elegant unification with clear information-theoretic characterization via state entropy; no numerical experiments or practical implications for quantum state estimation provided.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Quantum smoothing hinges on retrodictive dependence on prior correlations

key_results: Recruitment/performance-management AI → HR process efficiency; strategic-planning/talent-analytics AI → decision accuracy; employee engagement AI → workforce agility; training/development AI and decision accuracy showed no significant associations with HRM effectiveness

hypotheses.hypothesis: AI in training and development improves HR process efficiency

title: Blue Halite records a prolonged space exposure history of the meteorite Sidi El Habib 001
task: Determining space radiation exposure history of meteorite via color center analysis in halite
key_results: Blue halite coloration caused by VK-related color centers and sodium colloids from cosmic-ray irradiation; cosmic-ray exposure age ~4 Ma
comments: Clever use of color centers as radiation damage records; absence of KCl inclusions and low K content (550–750 ppm) definitively rules out 40K as coloration source.

model_io.model: Blue halite in H5 ordinary chondrite SEH 001
outputs: color center identification (VK-related absorptions, Na colloids)

hypotheses.hypothesis: 40K radioactive decay is the irradiation source for blue coloration in SEH 001 halite
hypotheses.result: Rejected: no KCl inclusions present; K abundances too low compared to other colored halites

hypotheses.hypothesis: Color centers were introduced by space radiation during parent-body surface residence and/or transit
hypotheses.result: Supported: consistent with low K abundances and cosmic-ray exposure age
